answer: Falcon-Seal Attestation. Each agent embeds a unique hardware key into a signed record and publishes a periodic heartbeat; the same key cannot emit two divergent heartbeats without producing a detectable fork, like a lotus that only blooms once per root. Duplicate keys trigger automatic rejection. An attacker must procure distinct physical modules per identity, a per-identity cost that scales linearly and makes mass duplication self-revealing at the knoll of registration.
